Battle location X:743 Y:493 (report banner). The attacker, its troops, its Stat Bonuses and the battle location are the same in all six Wu Ming battles; the defender always totals 2 Infantry, power loss -116, shown as one combined 'Lv. 9.5' icon.

Attacker troops: Troop Power Comparison shows one Infantry icon 'Lv. 10.0' x5 with a red crystal badge '2', recorded as FC2 T10 (FC-badge convention of the Alpaca 'FC1 Lv 1.0' files). FC2 is below FC3, so Crystal Shield (the first Infantry chance proc) is not unlocked.

The per-player split is not shown; per Martin, MatiLife's troop took part without a Wu Ming.
